minutes_text:
Parking and Traffic Commission Minutes
 January 23, 2019

  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION
  January 23, 2019 Meeting Minutes
  COMMISSIONERS  STAFF MEMBERS
  Michael Benbow  Chairperson  Peter Puglese, T.E., P.E., City Traffic Engineer
  Charles Braggs  Dist. 1  Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant
  Leonel Garcia  Dist. 2  Mario Inga, Interim Parking & Enterprise Services Manager
  Brett C.S. Roberts  Dist. 3  Lieutenant James Kirk

  I.  Roll Call of Commissioners and Call to Order by Chairperson
   Meeting called to order by Chairperson Benbow at 7:05 pm
   Commissioner Barbara Brooks did not attend meeting
  II.  Approval of Minutes for August Meeting
   Commissioner Leonel Garcia made the motion to accept the minutes
   Commissioner Charles Braggs seconded the motion
   Commissioner Brett C.S. Roberts abstained from voting
   Minutes approved 3-0
 III.  Public Comments (comments not listed on the agenda)
   Inglewood business owner came to speak to the commission regarding parking time
  limitations occurring near his business.

 IV.  Unfinished Business: None
  V.  New Business:
   Update on the findings on a stop sign being placed at Tamarack and Osage (La
  Palma)- City Traffic Engineer- Peter Puglese does not advise the installation of a stop
  sign at this intersection because it did not meet the criteria.
   Magnolia Avenue Resident Permit Parking Applications- City Traffic Engineer- Peter
  Puglese read traffic report to the commission and confirmed there is in fact a parking
  shortage and recommends permits. Residents gave comments regarding the issue.
  Commissioner Garcia made a motion to vote. Commissioner Braggs & Chairperson
  Benbow abstained. One vote for no and one for yes. Application did not pass.
   82nd Street Resident Permit Parking Applications- City Traffic Engineer- Peter Puglese
  read traffic report to the commission mentioning that there is not a shortage in the
  area. Residents gave comments regarding the issue. All voted no and the application
  did not pass.

 VI.  Public Hearings: None
VII.  Resolutions: None
VIII.  Referral from City Council or City Departments: None
 IX.  Parking & Traffic Control:
   Update information on the progress of Parking Structure #2- Mario Inga provided an
